Name: More Treasure Totems
Author: Suntooth
Description:
[size=3]This mod adds more types of Treasure Totem to the game. Some are balanced and useful, some... aren't.[/size]

[size=3]Current totems added:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Square Treasure Totem[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Ultra Treasure Totem[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Ultimate Treasure Totem[/size][/*]
[/list][size=3]Their effects, crafting recipes, and methods of obtaining are in the spoiler below:[/size]
[spoiler][list]
[*][size=3][b]Square Treasure Totem[/b]: Same radius as the vanilla totem but a square ring instead of circular. Crafting recipe is the same as vanilla except 20 Moss instead of 10. Buy the recipe from the Desert Trader for 5 Iridium Bars after gaining Foraging Mastery.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]Ultra Treasure Totem[/b]: A solid 9x9 square. Crafted with 10 vanilla Treasure Totems. Buy one totem from the Walnut Room shop for 30 Qi Gems, or the recipe for 100 Qi Gems after gaining Foraging Mastery.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]Ultimate Treasure Totem[/b]: Fills almost every single valid space on the current map with artifact spots. Cannot be crafted. Buy one totem from the Walnut Room shop for 70 Qi Gems after gaining Foraging Mastery.[/size][/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3]Alongside Content Patcher and SMAPI, both [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27100]BETAS[/url] are required for this mod to work. Other requirements may be added in the future.[/size]

[size=4][b]Known issues[/b][/size]
[size=3]The artifact spots spawned by these totems can be picked up like forageables. If you know how to fix this, please let me know.[/size]

[size=4][b]Thanks & self-promotion[/b][/size]
[size=3]Thank you to the multiple people in the Stardew Valley Discord that helped me figure out SpaceCore and BETAS![/size]

[size=3]Mods used in the screenshots:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21085]Starblue Valley[/url][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16626]Seasonal Clover Dig Spot[/url][/size][/*]
[/list][size=3]I spent a lot of time on this mod, and I'm incredibly proud of it. [b]If you enjoy it, please endorse or vote for it, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Suntooth/mods]check out my other mods[/url]![/b][/size]
